name.es: Tornillo Allen de cabeza cilíndrica M5x40
name.fr: Vis à tête cylindrique à six pans creux M5x40
name.pt: Parafuso Allen de cabeça cilíndrica M5x40

description.en: An ISO 4762 hexagon socket head cap screw, M5 × 40 mm. In a belt drive it is the axle of an idler stack — shims and flanged bearings, or a toothed idler — between two walls of a printed host, with the head on the outer face of one wall.
description.es: Un tornillo de cabeza cilíndrica con hexágono interior ISO 4762, M5 × 40 mm. En una transmisión por banda es el eje de una pila de polea loca — suplementos y rodamientos con pestaña, o una polea dentada — entre dos paredes de una pieza impresa, con la cabeza en la cara exterior de una de ellas.
description.fr: Une vis à tête cylindrique à six pans creux ISO 4762, M5 × 40 mm. Dans une transmission par courroie, c'est l'axe d'un empilage de galet — cales et roulements à collerette, ou un galet denté — entre deux parois d'une pièce imprimée, la tête sur la face extérieure de l'une d'elles.
description.pt: Um parafuso de cabeça cilíndrica com sextavado interno ISO 4762, M5 × 40 mm. Numa transmissão por correia é o eixo de uma pilha de polia louca — calços e rolamentos com flange, ou uma polia dentada — entre duas paredes de uma peça impressa, com a cabeça na face exterior de uma delas.

governing.designation: ISO 4762 hexagon socket head cap screw M5x40

sources.title: ISO 4762 / DIN 912 hexagon socket head cap screw, M5x40, 8.8 (product datasheet 240912540)
sources.supports: ISO 4762 M5x40: d 5 mm; l 40 mm; head diameter dk 8.5 mm; head height k 5 mm; hexagon socket s 4; socket depth t 2.5 mm; thread length b 22 mm

sources.title: Voron 2.4r2 build guide, version 2023-07-04 (VoronDesign/Voron-2 @ a192410, Manual/Assembly_Manual_2.4r2.pdf, GPL-3.0); cited by page and section only, nothing copied
sources.supports: pp. 65 and 69 (A/B Drives and Idlers): F695 bearings and M5 shims stack on an M5x40 SHCS; pp. 97–100 (Gantry, XY joints): F695 stacks and a GT2 20-tooth idler on M5x40 SHCS, the idler's screwed into plastic; p. 7 (Hardware reference): SHCS per ISO 4762

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the under-head bearing face, on the screw axis. +z runs along the shank to the tip at z = 40; the head lies on the −z side. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the screw is round, so both interfaces have continuous symmetry. The head_seat interface is the under-head face; journal sits journal_offset_mm along the shank, where the first carried part's face A lands; the rest of a stack follows by its neutral face mates.

thread_length.note: b; the shank is plain for the rest of the length

label.es: Desplazamiento del asiento desde la cabeza
label.fr: Décalage de la portée depuis la tête
label.pt: Deslocamento do assento desde a cabeça

parameters.note: A convention, not a sourced fact: the distance from the under-head face to the face A of the first part the shank carries (the host wall under the head plus any gap). The default 5 is a catalog convention for a 5 mm printed wall.

label.es: Asiento de la cabeza (bajo la cabeza)
label.fr: Appui de la tête (sous la tête)

interfaces.note: Male: the shank enters the host's clearance hole. The origin is the centre of the under-head bearing face; the normal points +z, along the shank, toward the host, so a hole framed at the host's outer face with its normal out of the hole (female) takes the screw with the head on that face.

Male: the shank carries an idler, a flanged bearing or a shim as an axle. The origin is where the carried part's face A lands, journal_offset_mm from the under-head face; the normal points +z, toward the tip, into the carried part, whose bore is framed at its face A with the normal out of that face (female).

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-AUTH-E lane, 2026-10-04); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: Retention of the tip (a nut, a tapped hole, or a pilot hole the screw cuts its own thread in) is the host's design and not modelled. Only the first carried part mates the journal; the parts after it are placed face to face (m5-axle-stack-face), so one screw carries a stack of any order.

envelope.note: Head and shank; the socket is not hollowed. The shank overlaps the hole or pilot it is driven into: declare it.
